retrieved_and_viewed.visible_evidence: Two gilled fruit bodies in leaf litter, photographed from above at an oblique angle. Larger cap is brown with a depressed-looking center and darker edge; smaller cap is paler.
Low-angle view of two fruit bodies among leaves and twigs. The larger brown cap has a downcurved edge and a slender yellow-brown stipe.
A closely comparable low-angle view showing both fruit bodies and their stipes among leaves and twigs.
Both fruit bodies above foil labeled AN2 F6. Woodland litter is visible; exact attachment substrate is unverified.
Accession-marked foil with the larger collected fruit body. The bent yellow-brown stipe and dark gilled underside are visible.
Accession-marked foil with two handled fruit bodies; the undersides show gills. Exact gill attachment is unresolved.
Two fruit bodies with yellow-brown stipes beside accession-marked foil. Soil and other specimen material are visible near the frame edges.
Second labeled laboratory view of two collected fruit bodies on paper. Yellow-brown stipes and adherent debris are visible. Other material appears near frame edges.
